entries.title: Dicey Dungeons
entries.definitive_edition: Dicey Dungeons on Windows PC with Reunion

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Reunion included; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with complete Reunion content.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game plus the free Reunion DLC, with PC capture/settings flexibility. Console and mobile versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dicey Dungeons on Steam, GOG, or itch.io for Windows PC and play the current build with the Reunion bonus episodes included.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reunion is a free DLC/update with six new episodes, not a separate remaster; make sure the current build includes it.
